name: Project change
description:
1. Reported bug: switching the active project didn't work and instead reloaded the page to `/<project_name>`.
2. Diagnosis: `activeProjectChanged()` ended with `syncRouteProjectPrefix()`, whose `router.replace()` fired on the desktop catch-all route and either navigated natively (full reload) or threw, aborting the switch.
3. Fix in `src/components/layout/AppsSection.vue`: replaced inline `@select` with an awaited `onProjectSelected()` handler — store-driven switch only, no route work, errors surfaced as notifications.
4. Fix in `src/store/project.js`: `syncRouteProjectPrefix()` now early-returns on route `codx-junior-split` and wraps `router.replace()` in try/catch (sync + async), so navigation can never break the project switch.
5. Result: URL/project-path sync is preserved for scoped single/mobile routes, while desktop project switching stays fully in-place without reloading.

history.summary:
1. Bug: switching the active project either reloaded the page at `/<project_name>` or silently did nothing.
2. Root cause: `activeProjectChanged` closed with `syncRouteProjectPrefix()`, whose `router.replace` ran inside its `try` block on the desktop catch-all route (`codx-junior-split`), so it navigated natively or threw and aborted the switch.
3. Fix in `src/store/project.js`: early-return on the catch-all route (project is not URL-scoped) and wrap `router.replace` in try/catch so it can never abort the store-driven switch.
4. Fix in `src/components/layout/AppsSection.vue`: `@select` now calls an awaited `onProjectSelected()` that no-ops on the current project, toasts errors, and emits `close` in `finally` — no route work in the component.
5. Result: in-place switching that keeps the shell mounted, identical behaviour for `PinnedProjectsSwitcher`, and a visible toast instead of a silent failure.
